Legal.governingNotice: The Indonesian language version of this document is the authoritative and legally binding text governing Batu Lawang & Gunung Bendera tourism operations; this English translation is provided for visitor convenience.
Legal.privacyIntro: We process your name, email address, WhatsApp number, ticket order records, and gate scan timestamps strictly for daily-quota ticketing, hiker safety, and compliance with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Act (Law No. 27 of 2022 / UU PDP).
Legal.privacyRights: Registered visitors may export all personal data in JSON format or request account deletion/anonymization at any time from the Profile & Privacy tab in their Dashboard.
Legal.privacyPhotos: All uploaded review photos and media assets are re-encoded to WebP and stripped of 100% of EXIF/GPS device metadata to protect your privacy.
Legal.termsIntro: Official e-tickets are valid exclusively on the scheduled WIB visit date. Regular Tickets grant entry only at Batu Lawang Gate, whereas hiking through the Gunung Bendera Trailhead requires Tiket Putih (White Ticket).
Legal.termsRefund: Refund requests may only be submitted for active tickets at least the required minimum hours prior to the visit date; daily quota is released once approved by an Operations Admin.
Legal.privacyLegalBasis: This Privacy Policy is established pursuant to Law of the Republic of Indonesia Number 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (UU PDP). Cupang Village Tourism Management serves as the Personal Data Controller responsible for handling tourist data accountably, transparently, and securely.
Legal.privacyDataTypes: Data collected includes: visitor identity (full name per ID), active contact details (verified email and WhatsApp number), ticket booking transaction details, gate scan validation history (WIB timestamp, entrance gate, scanning ranger), IP address, and session security audit records.
Legal.privacyPurposes: Your data is used solely for: (a) Issuance and delivery of encrypted QR daily-quota e-tickets; (b) Entrance verification at Batu Lawang gate and Gunung Bendera trailhead; (c) Emergency safety communication during hiking incidents; (d) Fraud prevention and request rate limiting.
Legal.privacySecurity: Ticket QR tokens are encrypted using AES-256-GCM with server-signed HMAC-SHA256 integrity verification. Uploaded visitor review photos are automatically processed using high-performance image pipelines to strip all EXIF metadata and device GPS coordinates.
Legal.privacyRightsDetail: Pursuant to Articles 5 through 13 of the UU PDP, you hold the right to access, rectify, obtain portable data copies in standard JSON format, and request account erasure or anonymization via the Profile & Privacy menu in the Member Dashboard.
Legal.termsRulesTitle: 1. General Rules & Area Code of Conduct
Legal.termsRules: Batu Lawang and Gunung Bendera nature reserve operates daily from 06:00 to 17:00 WIB. Visitors must uphold Leave No Trace environmental ethics (carry all trash back), refrain from unauthorized campfires, and preserve the ancient andesite rock cliffs.
Legal.termsAdmission: Regular Tickets are valid only for the Batu Lawang cliff area. Tiket Putih is valid for both destinations (Batu Lawang & Gunung Bendera hiking trail). Regular Ticket holders attempting summit entry will be rejected at the Gunung Bendera trailhead scanner and must obtain a Tiket Putih.
Legal.termsRefundDetail: Refund requests can only be submitted through the purchaser account prior to the 24-hour cutoff before the visit date (WIB). Tickets with any gate scan record cannot be refunded. Approved refunds are processed following managerial verification.
Legal.termsSafety: Management reserves the right to temporarily suspend trail access or viewpoints during extreme weather, torrential rain, landslide hazards, or civil emergency advisories. Tickets booked for dates affected by emergency closures may be rescheduled without additional fees.
